scope: 5c-1 only: one-ball capture through nip to frozen guide-entry plane; no basket delivery, multi-ball jam campaign or launch

geometry.guide_entry_basis: Frozen P2-40 rear-throat datum nip_u-105 mm; reaching this plane is stage 5c-1, not basket delivery.

motor_model.control: speed error requests current; terminal voltage is back-EMF plus I*R and is clamped to +/-12.8 V; current and torque are then recomputed from the clamped voltage

criteria.name: fully_through_nip
criteria.rationale: A 33 mm-radius ball is fully behind the geometric nip when its centre is one radius behind it.
criteria.source: Calibrated ball radius 0.033 m and frozen nip frame.

criteria.name: guide_entry_reached
criteria.rationale: Uses the existing frozen rear-throat datum; it does not claim downstream guide or basket delivery.

criteria.name: nip_exit_speed
criteria.rationale: Uses the lower edge of the stated 1.7-1.9 m/s guide requirement; 1.9 m/s is reported as the preferred-margin diagnostic.

criteria.name: plough
criteria.rationale: A ball pushed forward by more than 100 mm before crossing the nip is operational ploughing rather than capture; smaller contact transients are reported.
criteria.source: Defensible bound: greater than three ball radii and larger than the complete 77 mm cheek taper length.

criteria.name: jam
criteria.rationale: Half a second is longer than the nominal 105 mm guide-entry transit even at 0.21 m/s and distinguishes a persistent wedge from contact chatter.
criteria.source: Engineering bound; nominal required transit at 1.7 m/s is 0.062 s.

criteria.name: d5065_current
criteria.rationale: Existing provisional controller/pack gate; not the motor maximum.

criteria.name: d5065_torque
criteria.rationale: 20 A multiplied by Kt=0.031 N m/A.

criteria.name: forbidden_launcher_contact_count
criteria.rationale: Frozen P2-40 requires physical separation from ground/chassis; any contact stops the campaign for frame/model investigation.

criteria.name: contact_force
criteria.rationale: No calibrated cheek/guide stiffness or force acceptance requirement exists.

criteria.name: nip_exit_speed_preferred
criteria.rationale: Upper edge of the stated guide requirement is reported but not substituted for the accepted 1.7 m/s minimum.

failure_discipline: If any launcher-to-ground/chassis contact contradicts P2-40, stop before CAD changes and inspect model/frames.
